newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers Communications appoints Horn as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Rogers Communications appoints Horn as CFO.

text.p: Rogers Communications Inc said on Monday it had appointed Alan Horn as chief financial officer and vice-president of finance from today.
Horn already had been acting in these roles for the past two months, after replacing Graham Savage, who resigned.

Horn had been vice-president of administration for the debt-ridden mobile communications firm before Savage left unexpectedly. Savage had been considered a restraining force on flamboyant president Ted Rogers.

Ted Rogers said in a statement that "Alan's leadership and emphasis on team building has resulted in significant progress both internally and externally in the past two months." Rogers stock rose C$0.45 to C$10.35 in heavy trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Monday.
